answer.text:
A trial needs to reach a score of 31 points in Marketo before it counts toward MQL (Marketing Qualified Lead). This is specific to the trial threshold scoring model, which is separate from the standard MQL threshold of 100 points for other leads. Once a trial user hits 31 points, they are marked as MQL and excluded from further trial scoring. Note that leads with a generic email domain are excluded from MQLing via trials. The scoring mechanism runs twice daily per region and only considers trials within 40 days of starting.

Owner: Marketing Operations (@manav-gl, @anramirez)  
Source: [Marketo - Trial Threshold Scoring](https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/marketing/marketing-operations/marketo/#trial-threshold-scoring) [marketing/marketing-operations/marketo/_index#trial-threshold-scoring]
